profileText: I have 13+ years of experience in UI development technologies, including proficiency in HTML5, CSS3/SCSS/Sass, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, DOM, and React JS. Over the past 6 years, I have specialized in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gaining expertise in Lightning Web Components (LWC) and UI design using tools such as Figma and Adobe XD.

For over seven years, my career has included extensive collaboration with backend teams utilizing technologies like Drupal, Dot Net, Cake PHP, Magento, Yii2, and OpenCart. I have a comprehensive skill set in UI customization, covering everything from design to HTML and CSS, React JS, Angular, Aura, Vlocity Flex Card, OmniScript, and LWC.

Additionally, I have successfully managed teams and projects, leading and coordinating efforts to meet project milestones and deadlines. My versatility and experience make me a valuable asset in creating impactful user experiences and driving business growth through technology.
